If you notice anything breaking, it is entirely un-intentional, but you might also have been relying on [undocumented](https://www.hyrumslaw.com/) or [buggy](https://xkcd.com/1172/) behavior. body.title: fix(mr create): use --repo as source project when local remote is not a fork
body.description:
## What does this MR do and why?

Closes #8666.

When `glab mr create --repo <target>` is invoked without `--head` from inside a local git clone whose remote is an unrelated project (not a fork of `--repo`), `PreRun` previously resolved `headRepo` from the local git remote, causing `POST /projects/<local>/merge_requests` to fail with `422 Source project is not a fork of the target project`.

This MR:
1. Tracks whether `--head`/`GITLAB_HEAD_REPO` and `--repo`/`GITLAB_REPO` were explicitly provided.
2. When `--repo` is set without `--head` and the local remote's project is not `--repo` and not a fork of `--repo`, defaults `SourceProject` and `headRepo` to `--repo` (`baseRepo`) while preserving auto-detection for fork workflows.
3. Adds `TestNewCmdCreate_RepoOverrideUsesRepoAsSourceWhenLocalNotFork`.

Closes #8666
